bio: Glenn has over 30 years’ experience in mergers and acquisitions and technology law and is also recognised as a leading attorney in commercial litigation. Glenn has also advised clients on transactions in the mining, energy, electronic communications and financial services industries. bio:
Bradley is a commercial M&A lawyer with almost 30 years of experience. Bradley was trained in a large Johannesburg commercial firm and has practised as an M&A partner in the Johannesburg office of an international law firm.

Bradley is a co-founder of Stein Scop Attorneys. He is one of the foremost telecommunications and technology lawyers in South Africa having advised numerous industry participants. In this regard Bradley has supervised litigation in a number of industry defining matters.

Bradley’s transactional experience includes advising clients in relation to numerous transactions in the mining, media, telecommunications, engineering, financial services and banking industries. Bradley also has extensive experience in commercial transactions in a number of foreign jurisdictions predominantly on the African continent.

name: Amelia Berman
title: Consultant
bio: Amelia is an Employment and Labour attorney and CEDR Accredited Mediator. She specialises in Labour Court and Labour Appeal Court applications and trial work, with particular expertise in strike interdicts and review applications. She represents numerous clients across a number of industries and sectors including financial institutions, energy, infrastructure, mining and commodities, telecommunications, retail and private security. She provides her clients with strategic advice relating to unfair/automatically unfair dismissal disputes, sexual harassment disputes, poor performance management, terminations, retrenchments/restructuring, industrial relations, collective bargaining, recognition of majority unions, transfers and mergers as well as immigration law. She has extensive experience running arbitrations in the CCMA and in many bargaining councils and is particularly skilled at dispute resolution and negotiating/facilitating the settlement of disputes. Amelia’s expertise also includes drafting and reviewing permanent and fixed term employment contracts as well as contracts in respect of a-typical employees and independent contractors. Amelia obtained her Bachelor of Arts (majoring in Law and Industrial Psychology) and LLB degrees from the University of Witwatersrand and completed her articles at a large global law firm in 2010. She was admitted as an attorney of the High Court in April 2011 and practiced as an associate and senior associate at a large global law firm until she joined Stein Scop Attorneys Inc. as a director in 2016.

name: Natalie Napier
title: Consultant
bio:
Natalie is lawyer who specialises in all areas of tax law. Previously, she was a tax partner at top-tier law firms in South Africa. She has advised on a number of commercial transactions, many of which were cross-border, over the past 24 years. She has also assisted individuals with their personal tax queries.

Over time, Natalie’s practice has grown, and she now regularly acts for her clients who are being audited, or have been additionally assessed, by the South African Revenue Service. She lodges objections on behalf of clients and represents them at every stage in disputes with the South African Revenue Service, ensuring the protection of taxpayer rights.

Natalie reviews and comments on commercial agreements and, where it is necessary, advises on changes to agreements to ensure they are tax-efficient and to greatly reduce the risk of queries from the South African Revenue Service.
